description: This file contains the PHP class 'Search' in the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account'. It defines methods related to managing customer search data, including adding a new search record. The class extends a system engine model and interacts with the database to insert search keywords and related data.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: Represents the model for customer account searches, including methods to add search records to the database.

methods.name: addSearch
methods.description: Inserts a new customer search record into the database with details such as store ID, language ID, customer ID, keyword, category, sub-category, description, products, IP address, and timestamp.
